summary: The S&P 500 rose 0.32% today to 7,677.28, with tech stocks leading the way up 0.94%. Gold climbed 1.39% while oil fell 1.98% as Iran and Oman discussed reopening the Strait of Hormuz shipping lane, which would ease supply fears. Consumer confidence, which measures how optimistic Americans feel about the economy, slipped to 89.4 in August according to press coverage, below last month's 90.8 and below the forecast of 90.3. Tomorrow brings Nvidia earnings after the close and the Core PCE report, which is the Federal Reserve's preferred measure of inflation.
